verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only glancingly references library publishing via marketing bullet points ('Publish resources across teams', 'centralize assets, libraries, and workflows across departments') without any documentation of the actual mechanics of shared library publishing, component/style syncing, or controlled update notifications when a source file changes. Code Connect items relate to code-to-design mapping, not library update propagation. Missing for 10: dedicated documentation of shared library creation/publishing workflow, update notification/approval UI, team library permissions, and any independent corroboration of controlled update behavior.
